title: Pixel Art/8-bit
content: Apply pixel art/8-bit aesthetic reminiscent of retro games. Use blocky, pixelated graphics - apply image-rendering: pixelated. Limited color palettes (8-16 colors max). Pixel-style fonts for text. Include retro game UI elements: health bars, score displays, button prompts. Chiptune-inspired visual rhythm. Dithering patterns for gradients. CRT screen effects optional. Nostalgic 80s-90s gaming atmosphere.

variants.simple: Create retro pixel art aesthetic with blocky graphics, limited colors, and nostalgic gaming feel.
variants.detailed: Apply pixel art/8-bit aesthetic reminiscent of retro games. Use blocky, pixelated graphics - apply image-rendering: pixelated. Limited color palettes (8-16 colors max). Pixel-style fonts for text. Include retro game UI elements: health bars, score displays, button prompts. Chiptune-inspired visual rhythm. Dithering patterns for gradients. CRT screen effects optional. Nostalgic 80s-90s gaming atmosphere.
variants.advanced: Apply pixel art/8-bit aesthetic with retro gaming nostalgia. Pixel rendering: image-rendering: pixelated (or crisp-edges) on images and icons, scale up small pixel art. Color palettes: use authentic retro palettes - NES (54 colors), Game Boy (4 greens), C64, or custom limited palette (8-16 colors). Dithering: simulate gradients using dot patterns (CSS repeating patterns or SVG). Pixel fonts: use bitmap-style fonts (Press Start 2P, VT323, Silkscreen) at appropriate sizes (multiples of base). UI elements: chunky borders (border-4), blocky buttons, health/progress bars with segments. Game UI patterns: score displays, lives counters, menu boxes with thick borders. Animation: step-based animations (animation-timing-function: steps()), avoid smooth transitions. Sound visualization: represent audio with bouncing bars or waveforms. Sprites: character or mascot elements in pixel art style. CRT effects (optional): scan lines, slight curvature, color fringing using CSS filters and pseudo-elements. Screen bezel: optional frame suggesting old monitor or handheld device. Tile patterns: repeating background tiles like classic games. Interactive: 8-bit style hover states, pixel explosions, collectible animations. Implementation: CSS custom properties for palette colors, SVG for scalable pixel graphics. Accessibility: pixel fonts can be hard to read - provide size options, ensure sufficient contrast.
